title: Bangkok & Pattaya escape
rateNote: Two travellers · switch between land-only and flight-inclusive rates
alt: A long-tail boat travelling through tropical water in Thailand
description: Four days across Bangkok and Pattaya, with Coral Island, city sights, and selected meals. Choose land-only or flights-included pricing.
fullDescription: A 4-day, 3-night Bangkok and Pattaya package for two travellers. The land-only rate is ₹24,499 per person; the flight-inclusive rate is ₹52,000 per person. Includes accommodation, listed meals, transfers and sightseeing described in the itinerary. Confirm hotel availability, flight details, and final inclusions before booking.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Bangkok, continue to Pattaya
itinerary.text: Meet your local representative after arrival. Transfer to Pattaya with a Tiger Topia visit, breakfast, entry and photo, then check in. Enjoy lunch, a floating-market boat ride, the Alcazar Show, and dinner.

itinerary.title: Coral Island by speedboat
itinerary.text: After breakfast, take a half-day Coral Island trip by speedboat with shared transfers and lunch. Return to Pattaya for leisure time; dinner is at your own expense.

itinerary.title: Pattaya to Bangkok and city sights
itinerary.text: Check out and travel to Bangkok, visiting the Gems Gallery en route. See the Marble Buddha and Golden Buddha, check in, then enjoy dinner aboard the Chao Phraya cruise.

itinerary.title: Departure from Bangkok
itinerary.text: After breakfast, check out and enjoy free time for shopping and lunch at your own expense. Transfer to Bangkok International Airport for your departure.
